theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (u : Eucl P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), Measurable u → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, ε ≠ 0 → ∃ C : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ A ∧ μ (A \ C) < ε ∧ ContinuousOn u C
